title: LinkedIn Growth & Brand Associate
description:
**LinkedIn Growth \& Brand Associate** 




 Location: Remote
 



 Job Type: Internship / Part\-time
 



 Duration: 3 months
 



 Experience: 0–1 year
 



 Work Mode: Completely Remote
 



  





**Company Description** 




 ﻿Instainker is a specialized platform designed to manage and grow the LinkedIn presence of professionals who want results without becoming full\-time content creators. In a world where most LinkedIn users only consume content, Instainker helps clients unlock opportunities such as inbound job offers, premium clients, speaking invitations, and stronger professional reputations. The platform handles every aspect of LinkedIn activity, from optimizing profiles to creating posts that can go viral while clients focus on their core work. Unlike generic content tools or AI that loses context, Instainker functions as a complete LinkedIn operating system tailored to each individual’s professional identity. Team members work on products that directly impact careers and help professionals build long\-term visibility and influence.
 



  





**About the opportunity** 




 We’re looking for a few curious people who want to learn how LinkedIn actually works and build a strong personal brand along the way.This is a hands\-on opportunity to learn LinkedIn growth, personal branding, content creation and audience building while working with a startup.
 



  





 You don’t need a big following or previous content experience.
 



 If you’re willing to learn, experiment and stay consistent, this could be a great fit.
 


* What you’ll work onBuild and improve your LinkedIn presence
* Learn personal branding and content positioning
* Create and experiment with LinkedIn content
* Understand what makes content perform
* Learn audience and community building
* Experiment with different LinkedIn growth strategies
* Get exposure to how a startup builds its brand and community
* What we’re looking forStudents, freshers or early\-career professionals
* Genuine interest in LinkedIn and personal branding
* Good communication and writing skills
* Willingness to learn and experiment
* Consistency and ownership
* No prior experience required



  





**What you’ll get** 




 Completely remote opportunity
 


* Flexible working environment
* Hands\-on startup experience
* Guidance on building your LinkedIn presence
* Free access to our LinkedIn growth tool
* Certificate on successful completion
* Something tangible to add to your portfolio
* Opportunity to work closely with the team


- 


 Duration 3 months
 



  





 We’re keeping the first cohort small, so selected associates will get more hands\-on guidance and support.
 



  




1. How To Apply



 Keep it simple.Apply with:Your LinkedIn profile
 



 2–3 lines answering: What do you want to achieve with your LinkedIn profile?
 


* That’s it.No lengthy application. No fancy resume required.If you’re serious about building your LinkedIn presence while learning how startups work, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Web Strategy Manager
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a data\-driven Web Strategy Manager to own the performance, structure, and continuous improvement of our website from one of our India office locations. This role sits at the intersection of marketing, design, and technology, translating business goals into a web strategy that drives traffic, conversion, and pipeline.
   

  

 This is a strategy, prioritisation, and performance role rather than a primarily hands\-on build role. You will set the direction and the roadmap, run the experimentation programme, and work through the web development, design, and SEO members of the team to deliver. You will be expected to be technically fluent enough to scope work credibly, review quality, and troubleshoot alongside the team.
   

  

 This role also acts as a senior point of coordination for the India web team, partnering closely with the US\-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, delivery, and stakeholder communication.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Web Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Own the end\-to\-end web strategy, roadmap, and performance of the company website.
* Translate business and marketing objectives into a prioritised web roadmap, balancing impact, effort, and dependencies.
* Lead cross\-functional web projects from scoping through launch, coordinating with design, content, development, and external vendors.
* Manage project timelines, priorities, and delivery expectations, ensuring commitments are met and risks are surfaced early.


**Experimentation \& Conversion Optimisation**
* Design, execute, and analyse A/B and multivariate tests across landing pages, forms, CTAs, and key user flows to improve conversion.
* Build and maintain a testing roadmap prioritised by potential impact and effort, and report results to stakeholders.
* Apply sound experiment design, including hypothesis definition, sample sizing, and statistical significance.


**Search Visibility Direction**
* Set the direction and priorities for SEO and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), working through the SEO Specialist who owns hands\-on execution.
* Ensure organic search and AI\-driven answer experiences are factored into site structure, content planning, and page launches.
* Hold the team to search best practices across new builds and site changes.


**Measurement \& Reporting**
* Monitor and report on site performance using Google Analytics (GA4\), building dashboards and surfacing actionable insight for leadership.
* Establish and track the KPIs that define web performance, including traffic, engagement, conversion, and pipeline contribution.
* Monitor site health including page speed, mobile experience, accessibility, and broken links, and drive resolution.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Partner with SEO, content, demand generation, product marketing, and sales teams to align web strategy with broader business objectives.
* Coordinate closely with the US\-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and stakeholder communication.
* Provide direction, review, and quality oversight to the web development, design, and SEO members of the India team.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 6–9 years of experience in web strategy, digital marketing, growth marketing, or a related discipline, including experience setting direction rather than only executing.
* Proven, hands\-on experience with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation, including experiment design and interpreting statistical significance.
* Strong working knowledge of SEO fundamentals across technical, on\-page, and content, and familiarity with emerging AEO practices.
* Proficiency with Google Analytics (GA4\), including custom reports, funnels, and attribution.
* Working knowledge of Webflow, sufficient to scope work, review builds, and troubleshoot with developers.
* Experience with Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform for forms, landing pages, and lead flow.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to run multiple concurrent projects and keep cross\-functional teams on track.
* Experience guiding, reviewing, or coordinating the work of other specialists such as developers, designers, or analysts.
* Excellent analytical skills and the ability to turn data into clear recommendations, with strong written and verbal communication.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience with testing and optimisation platforms such as Optimizely or VWO is preferred.
* Basic HTML and CSS knowledge for troubleshooting Webflow builds is preferred.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, or Asana is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* A prioritised, consistently executed testing roadmap that improves key conversion metrics quarter over quarter.
* Measurable growth in organic search traffic and visibility, including AI\-driven search surfaces.
* A well\-maintained, fast, and reliable website with minimal downtime or technical debt.
* Web projects delivered on time, with clear scope and predictable quality.
* Clear, regular reporting that informs marketing and business decisions.
* The India web team operates with clear priorities and consistent standards.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Comfort making prioritisation calls and defending them with data.
* Technical fluency sufficient to earn credibility with developers and designers.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.


 Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Information Technology Support Specialist
description:

 At Opus, we grow together. Our team of bold thinkers and passionate doers is united by a shared mission to tackle meaningful challenges. title: Engineer II - Field Service
description:
**Job Description**
**Brief Job Description:**
**Brief Job Description**
 Responsible for providing on\-site and remote technical support, maintenance, and troubleshooting for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, PDU (Power Distribution Units), STS (Static transfer Switches), AHF (Active Harmonic filters) and other similar Power electronics products. The role requires extensive knowledge of UPS systems, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team to ensure the reliability and performance of power systems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

 Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network\-related issues affecting UPS performance.
   

  

 Assist in the configuration and commissioning of new UPS installations.

 Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance on UPS systems to ensure optimal performance.

 Experience with Vertiv Products is preferable.

 Strong understanding of electrical and electronics principles and UPS technology.
   

  

 Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing UPS systems.
   

  

 Familiarity with network protocols and remote monitoring tools.

 Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
   

  

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.

 The position may require travel to customer sites and may involve working in various environmental conditions.
   

  

 Flexibility to work outside regular business hours for emergency support and maintenance activities.

 Ability to travel as needed.

title: Consulting Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 Consulting Manager role in a global financial services practice responsible for delivering payment transformation and messaging optimization programs using SWIFT MT messages and ISO XML 20022 standards. The role focuses on advisory solution design and implementation oversight in a hybrid work model during day shifts ensuring secure efficient and compliant cross border payment operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead complex consulting engagements for financial institutions focused on modernizing cross border payment flows using SWIFT MT messages and ISO XML 20022 standards to achieve measurable gains in efficiency and compliance.
* Oversee end to end assessment of current payment messaging landscapes including processing workflows and system interfaces to identify gaps against evolving industry regulations and scheme requirements.
* Provide detailed advisory on migration strategies from existing SWIFT MT based processes toward ISO XML 20022 formats ensuring continuity of business operations and minimal disruption to clients.
* Drive design of target state payment messaging architectures that integrate SWIFT services core banking systems and downstream applications to support scalable and resilient transaction processing.
* Coordinate with product owners architects and operations teams to define functional and nonfunctional requirements for new or enhanced payment and messaging solutions aligned to client priorities.
* Develop clear and structured documentation including business process maps data models and message specifications for SWIFT MT and ISO XML 20022 to support implementation and testing activities.
* Guide testing strategies for payment messaging transformations including creation of test scenarios validation of message mapping and resolution of defects impacting transaction quality or timeliness.
* Analyze operational and financial metrics related to payment volumes straight through processing rates and exception handling to recommend targeted process improvements.
* Collaborate with risk and compliance stakeholders to ensure that SWIFT payment and messaging solutions adhere to regulatory expectations information security standards and industry best practices.
* Present concise and insightful findings to client management teams highlighting business impacts associated with messaging changes and providing clear recommendations for phased implementation.
* Support internal capability development by sharing knowledge on SWIFT MT standards ISO XML 20022 message structures and leading practices in payment transformation across consulting teams.
* Contribute to proposal creation and opportunity shaping by translating client needs in payment and messaging domains into well structured engagement plans and value propositions.
* Engage in continuous improvement of delivery methods by refining templates accelerators and reusable assets that reduce time to value for payment messaging consulting projects.


**Qualifications**
* Possess a strong foundation in SWIFT MT messages including understanding of core financial message types their fields and associated processing flows across correspondent banking networks.
* Demonstrate practical experience with ISO XML 20022 messages covering payment initiation clearing settlement and reporting structures as applied to real world implementations for financial institutions.
* Apply working knowledge of SWIFT payment and messages platforms including connectivity options and interface mechanisms to advise on optimal integration approaches with client systems.
* Bring proven consulting experience within financial services or payments domains spanning at least nine years with responsibility for delivering complex client projects and achieving defined outcomes.
* Show capacity to communicate technical messaging concepts in clear business oriented language enabling client stakeholders to make informed decisions about payment transformation journeys.
* Exhibit familiarity with hybrid work models and demonstrate ability to coordinate onsite and remote collaboration effectively during day shifts to maintain project momentum.
* Display strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to interpret payment data transaction flows and exception patterns to recommend practical remediation steps.
* Value inclusive and collaborative ways of working that encourage diverse perspectives and foster transparent interactions with client and internal teams throughout engagement lifecycles.

title: IGA Engineer
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 









 The
 
**Identity Governance Administration (IGA) Engineer**

 position requires technical knowledge and experience in implementing and supporting enterprise Identity Access Management platforms and systems. The role is responsible for the development and design of IGA system architecture, integrations and frameworks in an automated, measurable, and repeatable manner that aligns tightly with business.
 









 The IGA Engineer position requires technical knowledge and experience in implementing and supporting enterprise Identity Access Management platforms and systems. The role is responsible for the development and design of IGA system architecture, integrations and frameworks in an automated, measurable, and repeatable manner that aligns tightly with business needs.
   



**Responsibilities:**



* Strong understanding of Identity \& Access Management (IAM) User Lifecycle Processes including User Activity Monitoring, Access Re\-Certification, SOD, Reporting, IAM Standards and Policies
* Ability to lead or manage IGA engineering projects and team.
* Hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and deploying IAM/IGA solutions in an enterprise environment (e.g., Saviynt (preferred), SailPoint, Okta, etc.)
* Ability to on\-board third party and cloud applications utilizing various federation protocols within the IGA platform, as well as outside of the IGA platform.
* Ability to drive identity management strategically across the enterprise as a critical security pillar aligning where possible with IAM standard practices.
* Evaluate an application's user\-base with the business and determine if the application is a candidate for Role\-Based Access Controls.
* Identify data and process improvement ideas; contribute to the transformation of the Identity Access Governance function.
* Consistently demonstrates professional demeanor and communication skills with business partners and team members.
* Support day\-to\-day security controls including but not limited to creating access and control, monitoring, security awareness relating to BCBSMA mainframe, Active Directory, desktop computers, and remote access
* Maintain security governance and policies for business, groups, products \& security access types ensuring audit review approval.
* Ability to Implement/Customize IAM Workflows, Forms, Rules, Provisioning and Certifications



  


**Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:**



* Bachelors Degree in Information Technology or related field.
* 5\+ years in Information Technology.
* 2\+ years of experience in implementing IAM products (e.g., Saviynt, SailPoint, Okta, etc.).
* 2\+ years of leading IGA engineering projects and team.
* Experience in access control concepts, including access administration, directory services, SAML, LDAP, or PKI.
* Understanding of IAM standards like RBAC, SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect.
* Programming languages: PowerShell \& SQL, Computer networking, OS fundamentals (e.g., Windows/UNIX/Linux).
* Strong communication skills to articulate technically complex issues to non\-IAM teams.
* Knowledge of agile development methodologies and DevOps tools for continuous deployments.




 Strong pluses:
 



* Experience with (including technical certifications for):
 
	+ Saviynt, SailPoint IIQ or IDN, Oracle Identity Governance, One Identity, RSA or other user identity lifecycle management solution products or role\-based access control solutions.
	+ Azure AD, OKTA, or other single sign\-on, multi\-factor and federation solutions.
	+ ADSI and ServiceNow integration with IGA platform is a big plus.
	+ PAM solutions: BeyondTrust, CyberArk, Thycotic, Centrify, Hashicorp, or other privilege accounts lifecycle management solutions.
	+ Directory services (e.g., AD) / Virtual Directory services (e.g., Radiant Logic).
* Experience defining or re\-engineering IAM related processes, including incident management, change management, and configuration management.
* Experience in Policy Based Access Control (PBAC), SOD, or risk\-based access controls.
* Experience presenting to executive level client stakeholders.
* CISSP, CISA or CISM certification.



















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

title: Negotiable Area Regional Director of Population Health (N-B) PCN 1757568
description:
**This is the life\-changing opportunity you’ve been looking for.**
**Horizon Health Network in beautiful New Brunswick is looking for a Regional Director of Population Health to join our team!**
 Horizon Health Network (Horizon) is seeking a
 *strategic, motivated, and agile* 
 individual to join our team as a Regional Director of Population Health. The ideal candidate will be a senior expert on population health, providing expertise and strategic support regionally on population health initiatives, system improvements and identifying and addressing health disparities within a large organization.
   

  

**Why you should work here**
 Working for Horizon gives you a career that provides an east coast lifestyle and the chance to make a big difference in the lives of New Brunswickers.
   

  

 This position comes with competitive salary, paid time off, sick benefits, employer paid contributions into our government pension plan and a remote work policy.
   

  

 Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You hold a master’s degree in health or social science discipline. A concentration of study or advanced degree on population health and/or social determinants of health is considered an asset for this position. You have the ability to work with minimal supervision and possess strong organizational and time management skills. You have 7 to 10 years progressive leadership experience with experience in human resource and financial management, problem solving and critical thinking. You have additional training in project management and organizational change/improvement and trauma informed care (an asset). Using a Two\-Eyed seeing approach, you foster an environment that supports traditional Indigenous ways of knowing \& healing practices with evidenced based quality care. You also possess additional experience leading collaborative initiatives in a clinical setting (asset). You have demonstrated program and project leadership skills, including expertise in planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Develop and execute strategic plans in addition to develop, implement, monitor, and evaluate operational plans related to Population Health services in alignment with Horizon’s Strategic Plan.
* Provide strategic leadership to Horizon Health Network in the adoption of evidence\-informed approaches to improve population health and effect system transformation.
* Identify and support research, best practices and projects that align with the mandate and strategic direction of the department and Horizon Health.
* Support the facilitation of a Two\-Eyed Seeing approach to wellbeing and care of Indigenous clients and building these systems within Horizon Health Network.
* Serve as a strategic business partner, advisor, and leader to influence all levels of the organization by providing and executing responsive solutions.
* Work closely with Department of Health and other government departments and external stakeholders to enhance policy and strategically support the delivery of population health priorities and assure the modernization and effective delivery of population health services.
* Leads a regional approach to evidenced based practices in community engagement in collaboration with public health, primary care, addictions and mental health partners as well as other stakeholders in Horizon.
* Supervise multiple operational population health teams delivering services within Horizon and communities within New Brunswick.
* Oversee, monitor, and evaluate the quality and safety of Population Health services.
* Prepare, manage, monitor, and report on budgets and ensure fiscal responsibility within all departments.
* Develop, review, revise, monitor and report on performance indicators.
* Oversee the processes that ensure adherence with professional practice standards, policies, and procedures.
* Oversee human resource planning, skill optimization \& utilization, productivity \& capacity enhancements and assist with recruitment and retention activities.
* Build and maintain relationships with physicians and internal and external stakeholders, including integration of population health approaches within the overall Community portfolio and within the larger Horizon system.
* Participate/coordinate quality improvement activities and risk management processes to improve quality of care with a specific focus on taking a regional approach to improvements \& increased accountability, accessibility, productivity, capacity, responsiveness.
* Provide leadership and oversight of standardization of policies and procedures across all zones in collaboration with local Directors and Managers of Population Health and Public Health.
* Address strategic priorities related to health equity and the social determinants of health by building capacity in the organization is a focus of this portfolio.
* Travel throughout the region/province as required.


***Horizon Competency***
 Core competencies for non\-bargaining positions are based on the LEADS in a Caring Environment leadership capabilities framework: Lead Self, Engage Others, Achieve Results, Develop Coalitions, and System Transformation.
   

  

 In addition to LEADS, all positions need to demonstrate compassion, patience, and professionalism in all interactions, consistently upholding a respectful and supportive environment for patients, clients, families, and colleagues. Proactively addresses concerns and responds to emerging needs with empathy and diligence, contributing to high\-quality, patient/client centered care.
   

  

**Interested? Apply Today!**
 To learn more, visit
 **MyHorizonCareer.ca/management\-business\-professionals/**
 Horizon Health Network (Horizon) only accepts on\-line applications.
   

  

**About Horizon’s Recruitment Process**
 We thank all applicant who apply; however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted. All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.
   

  

 Horizon’s recruitment screening process may include language proficiency testing, clerical testing and/or behavioral assessment. If you are selected for testing, you will be contacted via the email address provided on your application. The official results will be shared with the candidate, Human Resources and the requesting manager electronically and language results will be placed on the personnel file for Horizon’s hiring purposes.
   

  

**Diversity Statement**
 Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care.

title: E-commerce Expert
description:

 Role: Full\-Time

title: Member of Technical Staff - Remote Role
description:
**About Wind River**
 Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission\-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.
   

  

 Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world.  Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.
   

  

 The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer\-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion \& belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world.
   

  

  

  

**YOUR ROLE**
 For this position, you will be joining the Engineering Operations team as a member of technical staff, focusing on application maintenance and improvement. Your main duties will focus on GitLab, supporting its user base and expanding its capabilities in collaboration with Engineering teams. You will also be called upon to support other Engineering applications, e.g., Confluence, CodeCollaborator, etc
   

  

 In your daily job you will:
 **Position is 8AM\-5PM Pacific Time Zone (India Night Shift).
   

  

 fully remote role**
**What You'll Do**
* Support and expand GitLab and other applications
* Work with internal customers on application issues
* Participate in global infrastructure \& development projects
* Provide guidance on technical issues and process to junior members of the team
* Perform code and design reviews


**How You Will Contribute**
**Education \& Experience**
* BE / MTech degree with min 8 to 12 Years of Experience(Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent technical degree)
* 5\+ years supporting and expanding GitLab, including Agile Planning, pipelines, CI/CD, administration of users and groups/projects, and deep familiarity with the APIs
* 3\-5 years in front\-line application support \& customer interaction
* 3\-5 years Linux user experience, with system admin experience a plus
* 5 years Jenkins administration experience
* 5 years Kubernetes development experience
* Programming \& scripting experience using Python, Shell, REST API services, etc.
* Experience with monitoring \& logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, etc.
* Understanding of MySQL \& PostgreSQL a plus
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical skills
* Self\-managed and fast learner
* Good verbal and written communication skills and a good listener
* Exceptional team player who works well in collaborative situations


**It’s What We Offer You**
* Working Hours The expected working hours for this role are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST, these hours are required as the position will be supporting the Engineering team in the U.S.
* Work Location This is intended to be a fully remote role. The employee will not be required to attend the office on a regular basis.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and life insurance
* Short and long\-term disability coverage
* RRSP matching for financial security
* Employee assistance program for mental well\-being
* Learning benefits, including a LinkedIn Learning subscription and seminars

title: Link Building/Outreach Specialist
description:
**About Eqvista** 




  





 Eqvista is a leading provider of valuations and equity management solutions, trusted by thousands of founders, SMEs, unicorns, and VCs. With over $200 billion in equity valued, Eqvista leverages an AI\-powered and human\-delivered approach, providing top\-rated services through its Real\-Time Company Valuation® platform and NACVA\-certified analysts. The company is recognized for delivering the fastest, most cost\-effective, and accurate valuations, all bundled with a premium cap table platform at no extra cost. Eqvista supports over 23,000 companies with cap table management, equity solutions, and tools for strategic decision\-making, ensuring timely updates and unmatched market insights.
 



  





 Please visit: https://www.linkedin.com/redir/suspicious\-page?url\=https%3A%2F%2Feqvista%2ecom%2F to learn more about our company.
 



 For more open position, please visit: https://www.linkedin.com/redir/suspicious\-page?url\=https%3A%2F%2Feqvista%2ecom%2Fcareers%2F
 



  






 We're seeking an experienced
 
**Link Building/Outreach Specialist** 

 with a specialization in community platform engagement — particularly Quora, Reddit, and LinkedIn — to join our digital marketing team. The ideal candidate combines strong traditional link\-building and off\-page SEO skills with deep, hands\-on fluency in how these community platforms work, including their unwritten norms, moderation practices, and community guidelines.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Develop and execute link\-building campaigns aligned with SEO goals, with a strong emphasis on community\-driven strategies on Quora, Reddit, and LinkedIn.
* Identify high\-value subreddits, Quora spaces/topics, and LinkedIn groups relevant to our niche, and build a sustainable presence within each.
* Navigate and strictly comply with each platform's community guidelines, subreddit\-specific rules, and self\-promotion policies to avoid bans, shadow\-bans, or reputational damage.
* Craft and place high\-quality Quora answers, Reddit posts/comments, and LinkedIn articles/posts that naturally earn backlinks, referral traffic, and brand credibility.
* Build and maintain relationships with publishers, bloggers, subreddit moderators, and industry influencers for backlink and collaboration opportunities.
* Conduct targeted outreach to bloggers, webmasters, and platform community members for guest posting and backlink opportunities.
* Monitor backlink performance and analyze competitors' link and community\-engagement profiles using tools like Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Majestic.
* Collaborate with the content and SEO teams to create linkable assets (guest posts, data\-driven content, infographics) suited for community distribution.
* Ensure all link\-building and community activities comply with Google's Webmaster Guidelines, platform\-specific policies, and ethical SEO practices.
* Prepare regular reports on KPIs such as domain authority, referral traffic, community engagement metrics, and ranking improvements.



  





**Experience:** 




  




* 3–5\+ years of proven experience in link building or off\-page SEO, including a documented link\-building strategy background.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience building presence, credibility, and backlinks specifically on Quora, Reddit, and LinkedIn — not just general social media.
* Strong working knowledge of Reddit's culture and moderation norms (subreddit\-specific rules, karma building, avoiding self\-promo flags), Quora's content and space policies, and LinkedIn's algorithm and publishing/community best practices.
* Strong understanding of SEO metrics, domain authority, and link quality evaluation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft persuasive, platform\-appropriate outreach and community content.
* Hands\-on experience with SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Google Search Console).



  





**Prefered:** 




  




* Experience in digital PR or content\-driven link acquisition.
* Familiarity with technical SEO concepts and keyword strategy.
* Prior experience working with SaaS or B2B startups.
* A track record of Reddit/Quora accounts or LinkedIn profiles with established karma, reputation, or follower credibility built through genuine participation.



  





**Benefits:** 



* Competitive salary
* Flexible work environment (remote/hybrid options).
* Career growth within a fast\-scaling marketing team.
* Access to leading SEO tools and professional development resources.



  






 If you're passionate about community\-driven link building, we'd love to hear from you! Please send your resume, a brief cover letter explaining your approach to link building and community platform engagement, and 1–2 examples of successful outreach or community campaigns you've managed (Quora, Reddit, or LinkedIn examples strongly preferred).
 




  





 Apply now to join our team as a
 **Link Building/Outreach Specialist** 
 !

title: Coordinator, Sponsorship Effectiveness
description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.
   

  

 Come join our 31,000\+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!
   

  

**Employee Contract Type**
 Local \- Fixed Term Employee (Fixed Term)
   

  

**Job Description**
* Job Profile


 Coordinator, Sponsorship Effectiveness \- WV India
   

  

* Job Description


**Job Title :** 
 Coordinator – Sponsorship Effectiveness
   

  

**Location :** 
 Dhar Area Development Program,
   

  

**Position Reports To :** 
 Project Officer, Area Development Program
   

  

**Compensation :** 
 25000/\- per month
   

  

**Purpose of Job**
 Coordinator Sponsorship Effectiveness has to ensure the well\-being of children in the target area through monitoring of child progress and interfacing with the sponsor and community. Also has to facilitate the ‘relationship’ and ‘transformational impact’ between Sponsors/Donors, children, families and communities in ADPs / Projects.
   

  

 Ensuring sponsorship business and systems processes are in accordance with Partnership Sponsorship Standards and Policies. This position is based at ADPs / Projects in rural/ urban areas sometimes very remote without proper access to transportation, communication, education, and health services. The incumbent has to adopt to new and challenging environment.
   

  

**Key Deliverables**
* Monitoring of child progress
* Ensure the presence \& participation of children in programmes
* Manager the children portfolio as per sponsorship standards4\. Engage and facilitate quality and timely communication
* Support Area Development Program implementation


**Role**
**Child Well\- being**
* Ensure the wellbeing of children in the communities through monitoring of child progress
* Coordinates and provides support to ensure Child Monitoring Standards are met.
* Works closely with Project coordinator to ensure all RCs are impacted through CMS process (presence, Health, education, participation and protection). Child Well\-being issues are addressed by the ADP.
* Child related data/records are current and updated. Data entry, data quality, monitoring, tracking, exception reports, follow up reports
* Periodically Generates report and keep the Project officer and the team informed on the status of child monitoring
* Conduct visits to community on a weekly basis for reviewing the well\- being of children \& for quality
* Identify if there are any concerns on the well \-being of children and ensure it is highlighted to be addressed through programs.
* Raise awareness on Child Protection and reporting mechanism. Take appropriate efforts to report Registered Child protection incidents if any.


**Sponsor Communication**
* Facilitate timely \& Quality communication which contributes to rich \& meaningful engagement of sponsors
* Ensure children’s engagement in correspondence leads to improved /enhanced child participation and eventually quality of correspondence.
* Ensure Sponsorship Operations Indicators (SOIs) are above 95% (ie. Introductory Letter, Reply Letter, Support Office Queries, Gift Notification, Annual Progress Report, Greeting Card, Sponsor Visits).
* Ensures the targets are met in delivering of all the Sponsorship Rich Media content \- Child and Community Content
* Periodic training and refresher to be given to PCs on Sponsorship Standards, Child sponsorship field guide on correspondence and media content, HOPE/Horizon app.


**Integrated Program activities for children**
* Ensure Sponsorship activities are integrated with programs \& activities (Plan)
* Ensure that every RC participates in and benefits from the programmes.
* Every child participation to be capture in HOPE with appropriate participation codes to convey the impact to sponsors.
* Usage of HOPE data / reports on a regular basis to focus on issues relating to child well being.


**RC Portfolio Management**
* Coordinate overall process of child selection including timeframe, and documentation
* Ensure monitoring of RC inventory on an ongoing basis.
* Coordinates information management – data entry, quality and record management.
* Regular updates to the ADP team on RC recruitments to maintain the planned RC numbers.


**Skills**
* Written and verbal local language
* Computer knowledge (proficiency in MS Office)
* Organising, Planning \& Interpersonal skills


**Knowledge \& Qualification**
* Bachelor’s Degree/ Post Graduate degree


**Experience**
* 0 – 3 years experience in social work activities


- 

**Applicant Types Accepted**
 Local Applicants Only

title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Revenue Operations (India Remote) - Hours 1-9pm IST
description:
**Company Description**
  

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
   

  

 Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.
   

  

 You own the models, pipelines, and tests that everything downstream depends on. You're not a ticket\-taker: we expect you to understand why a metric matters before you model it, and to say so when the requirement as stated will produce a number that's technically correct and practically wrong.
   

  

 This is an early\-stage function, so you'll have unusual influence over how it's built.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Lead the migration of legacy Alteryx workflows into documented, tested dbt models on Redshift.
* Design models with deliberate grain and clear lineage, building toward a certified set of marts that reporting reads from.
* Own orchestration, monitoring, and alerting in Dagster (or Airflow), and the ingestion layer feeding it.
* Keep Redshift fast and cost\-effective.
* Trace issues to the right root cause — reporting, data model, or upstream business process — and route each to the right fix.
* Build the data foundations behind RevOps initiatives such as account\-based marketing, customer health scoring, and predictive work like churn and lead scoring.
* Use AI and LLM tooling thoughtfully in the engineering workflow, and help the team form a view on where it belongs.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**What We're Looking For**
* A self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, leads with questions, and doesn't wait to be assigned work.
* A translator who can explain a data problem to a Sales Director in terms of their quota, and a quota problem to an engineer in terms of a data model.
* A systems thinker who looks upstream and downstream before proposing a fix.
* Someone constructively skeptical who reconciles the numbers before shipping them.
* Impact\-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.
* An owner who takes pride in the cleanliness of their code and their documentation.


**Essential**
* 6 \- 8\+ years in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence with substantial hands\-on modeling responsibility.
* Proven experience building and maintaining production\-grade dbt projects, including testing and documentation.
* Hands\-on production experience with Dagster or Airflow.
* Advanced SQL and real experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake / BigQuery), including performance tuning.
* Git\-based workflow, code review, and CI as a normal part of how you work.
* Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model.
* Python for data work and automation.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Alteryx, particularly in a migration context.
* Experience with Airbyte, Dagster \& DBT or comparable ELT tooling.
* Salesforce\-specific data modeling experience.
* Exposure to predictive modeling or machine learning workflows.
* Experience with large customer engagement datasets (1M\+ rows).
* Ability to build and maintain Tableau dashboards, even if it isn't your primary craft.


  

  

**Additional Information**
  

**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  

 At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
   

  

 In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being.
   

  

**Our Mission** 
 is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
   

  

  

  

**Our Values** 
 underpin everything we do.
   

* **Customer Centric:** 
 Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:** 
 We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:** 
 Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action \& Ownership:** 
 We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:** 
 We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:** 
 We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.


**Global Benefits**
* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self\-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days \+ Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*


 \* varies by country
   

  

**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  

 At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

title: Storefront and eCommerce
description:
* About the role


 As our Storefront and CRO Manager, you will be the centre of expertise for everything that happens on our storefronts. You will own and drive the storefront experience for Crazy Domains, Vodien and BigRock, and support the wider Digipac group of brands.
   

  

 Our brands sit across a mix of platforms including WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager and our own in\-house stack, with control panels managed separately. A significant part of this role is bringing a coherent roadmap, one standard of experience and one testing discipline across all of them, while respecting where each brand needs to be different.
   

  

 You will be accountable for the storefront roadmap and for the commercial outcomes that come with it, with a focus on conversion rate, cross sell, and the overall quality of the customer experience. You will work with marketing, design, engineering, analytics and brand teams to make sure everything that ships is consistent with our wider eCommerce and marketing strategy.
   

  

 This role offers a largely remote working experience with flexible working hours and the opportunity to work with teams across the globe.
   

  

* Job Description


**What You Will Own**
 Targets are agreed by brand at the start of each financial year with the eCommerce and brand leads. Baselines are set in your first quarter.
   

  

**Revenue and conversion**
* Storefront conversion rate. Improve visit to cart and cart to purchase across priority funnels for each brand.
* Cross sell and attach rate. Grow attach of adjacent products at cart, checkout and in the control panel, measured by attach rate and revenue per visit.
* Average order value and revenue per session. Own the onsite levers that move both, including merchandising, pricing presentation, bundling and upgrade paths.


**Experience And Performance**
* Site performance. Page load and Core Web Vitals on key templates, with particular attention to mobile.
* Experience quality. Reduction in onsite defects reaching production, faster time to resolution on storefront bugs, improved task success and friction scores from behavioral and qualitative research.
* Consistency across brands. A shared component and experience standard applied across the portfolio, so that a fix or a win on one brand can be reused rather than rebuilt.


**Delivery and process**
* Experimentation velocity. An agreed number of tests live per quarter, each with a documented hypothesis, a clean readout and a decision logged, whether the test wins or loses.
* Roadmap delivery. Percentage of committed roadmap delivered in the quarter, and cycle time from PRD to live.
* Delivery against Strategi Project. Own and deliver platform support where applicable for strategic global projects such as brand migrations and consolidations


**A day in the life of our Storefront and Conversion Manager**
**Core deliverables**
* Build, maintain and track the storefront and control panel roadmap across Crazy Domains, Vodien, BigRock and the Digipac brands, keeping it continuously aligned with business strategy and with the commercial priorities of each brand.
* Manage the execution of storefront and customer panel driven marketing, UX and product initiatives from idea through to live.
* Run a continuous onsite testing program, using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and other forms of customer insight, and turn what you learn into a prioritized backlog rather than a folder of results.
* Create PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and build wireframes and high level mockups in Figma alongside our Design team to define desired outcomes.
* Make and manage day to day content, layout and campaign updates on our WordPress properties, and scope and brief larger changes to engineering for our AEM and in\-house stacks.
* Lead storefront redesign and rebranding work as it comes up, covering page templates, navigation, product and pricing pages, cart and checkout.
* Worl closely with storefront QA and pre release teams, so that what goes live matches what was specified and does not quietly break something else.
* Actively participate in and represent marketing in weekly project grooming, sprint planning and release readiness in Jira.
* Continuously measure and report key storefront metrics including conversion rate, click and engagement metrics, funnel drop off and load time.


**Stakeholder management**
* Proactively manage all relevant stakeholders including senior management, building consensus and commitment to project outcomes.
* Work with brand and marketing leads across the portfolio to sequence competing requests into a single roadmap, and be comfortable explaining why something is not being built this quarter.
* Work collaboratively with cross functional stakeholders and in close conjunction with design and engineering teams to align on roadmaps and deliverables across all three stacks.
* Engage and cultivate relationships with partners across the business, gain insight and adopt best practices.
* Partner closely with Analytics and BI teams to evolve our understanding of performance across eCommerce.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales and support teams on go to market planning for products and campaigns.
* Close the loop with customer support and care teams, using what they hear every day as a source of onsite improvements.


**Data and analysis**
* Monitor, report and find ways to improve platform performance across brands and funnel steps.
* Work with the BI team to build visibility for key platform metrics, including dashboards that let brand teams self serve.
* Investigate anomalies and conversion drops quickly, and separate a tracking problem from a real experience problem.
* Analyze data from internal and external sources to develop strategies and define platform objectives.
* Leverage data and insight to continually optimize and maximize the value of our platform and processes.
* Benchmark our storefronts against competitors and against good practice outside our category.


* Additional Job Description


**What You Will Need To Succeed**
* Five or more years in eCommerce, conversion rate optimization, digital product or web experience roles, ideally across multiple brands or markets.
* A demonstrable track record of moving conversion rate, attach rate or average order value, with the ability to talk through how you did it and what you learned when it did not work.
* A keen eye for good design and a strong understanding of user experience.
* A customer first mindset and the ability to apply design thinking principles.
* Data driven, but able to make a judgement call when the data is thin or the sample is small.
* Strong working knowledge of tracking customer journeys, event and tag setup, and the ability to analyze and act on what you see.
* Hands on experience with Figma and Jira. Both are everyday tools in this role, not occasional ones.
* Comfortable working directly in AEM/WordPress (or have the willingness to learn this). You should be able to make and QA basic content, layout and template updates yourself without waiting in a development queue. Experience with Adobe Experience Manager or a similar enterprise CMS is a strong advantage.
* A working understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Enough to read a page, spot what is wrong, estimate effort and hold a credible conversation with engineers. You will not be asked to ship production code.
* Experience with analytics and experimentation tooling such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and similar.
* Strong communication, organizational and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail, comfort with multitasking, and a customer service focus.
* Independent thinking, and not being afraid to suggest new ideas.
* Experience working in an agile organization or with cross functional teams.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
* Driven by delivery, delivering on time and to a high standard.


**Nice to have**
* Experience in domains, hosting, SaaS or subscription businesses.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and how onsite changes affect organic performance.
* Exposure to Adobe Analytics or Adobe Target.
* Working knowledge of accessibility standards and page speed optimization.
* Experience working across multiple time zones and distributed teams.


**What Success Looks Like**
**First 90 days.** 
 You know our stacks, our funnels and our numbers. You have audited the storefronts across brands, established a clean baseline for conversion, attach and performance, and shipped a first set of quick wins.
   

  

**First six months.** 
 A prioritized storefront roadmap is agreed with brand and engineering leads, a regular testing cadence is running, and reporting is in place that everyone trusts and uses.
   

  

**First twelve months.** 
 Measurable improvement against your conversion, attach and performance targets, a shared experience standard applied across brands, and a healthy backlog of tested, evidenced ideas ready for the following year.
   

  

**Why you'll love us.**
* We've evolved; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work\-from\- home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.
* Work\-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 \+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* We care about you. At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with \#teamnewfold
